title: Blink Wallet Adds Inactivity Fee to Custodial Accounts, Accelerating Migration to Self Custody
summary:
Bitcoin Magazine

Blink Wallet Adds Inactivity Fee to Custodial Accounts, Accelerating Migration to Self Custody

Blink Wallet began charging a $1 monthly fee on custodial accounts inactive for 12 months, with the first charges processed by mid-October 2026 and full refunds on login.
